data.name: How_Title
data.value: No reports needed. The lake tells us itself.

data.name: How_Model_Label
data.value: 01 · Lake model

data.name: How_Model_Title
data.value: Temperature at every depth

data.name: How_Model_Text
data.value: Eawag lake models calculate up to four days ahead how warm it is at 0, 10, 20 and 30 m and where the thermocline lies.

data.name: How_Satellite_Label
data.value: 02 · Satellite

data.name: How_Satellite_Title
data.value: Clarity and algae

data.name: How_Satellite_Text
data.value: Once or twice a week, satellite images show how clear the surface is and whether algae are spreading.

data.name: How_Weather_Label
data.value: 03 · Weather and inflows

data.name: How_Weather_Title
data.value: Wind, rain, discharge

data.name: How_Weather_Text
data.value: Heavy rain makes inflows murky, wind stirs up the shore. Both go into the index.

data.name: How_Community_Label
data.value: 04 · Community (bonus)

data.name: How_Community_Title
data.value: Reports sharpen the model

data.name: How_Community_Text
data.value: Reporting the visibility after a dive improves the forecast. It is not required.

data.name: About_Lead

data.name: About_Nav_Label
data.value: Contents of this page

data.name: About_Forecast_Title
data.value: How the forecast works

data.name: About_Forecast_Lead
data.value: No reports needed: the lake tells us itself. Twice a day a job fetches data from four sources and calculates the dive index for every site for five days.

data.name: About_Levels_Title
data.value: How precise is the forecast?

data.name: About_Levels_Lead
data.value: Every site has a data level. It shows how close the data is to the site.

data.name: About_Level_3
data.value: Precise: temperature profile at the site from the Eawag 3D lake model.

data.name: About_Level_2
data.value: Water body: profile for the whole lake from the 1D model, for rivers a FOEN gauging station.

data.name: About_Level_1
data.value: Weather: only wind and rain at the site. An index exists only with a satellite image.

data.name: About_Index_Note
data.value: The dive index (0 to 10) is an indicator, not a guarantee of visibility. Check the conditions on site, and never dive alone.

data.name: About_Sources_Title
data.value: Data sources

data.name: About_Sources_Lead
data.value: We show all data with attribution. The pages read only our own database; only the job queries the sources.

data.name: About_Source_Alplakes_Name
data.value: Eawag Alplakes

data.name: About_Source_Alplakes_Text
data.value: Lake models (3D and 1D) with the temperature at depth, plus satellite data on clarity and algae. © Eawag.

data.name: About_Source_Weather_Name
data.value: MeteoSwiss via Open-Meteo

data.name: About_Source_Weather_Text
data.value: Weather models ICON-CH1 and ICON-CH2 by MeteoSwiss (open government data) and ICON by DWD, retrieved via Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0).

data.name: About_Source_Hydro_Name
data.value: FOEN hydrological data

data.name: About_Source_Hydro_Text
data.value: Discharge and water temperature from the gauging stations of the Federal Office for the Environment, retrieved via existenz.ch. Open government data with attribution.

data.name: About_Source_Swisstopo_Name
data.value: swisstopo

data.name: About_Source_Swisstopo_Text
data.value: National map, aerial imagery (SWISSIMAGE) and lake depth data (swissBATHY3D) for the depth contours. Open government data, © swisstopo.

data.name: About_Source_Osm_Name
data.value: OpenStreetMap

data.name: About_Source_Osm_Text
data.value: Initial set of dive sites with name, location and some details. © OpenStreetMap contributors, Open Database License (ODbL). The data we took over is also available under the ODbL.

data.name: About_Privacy_Title
data.value: Privacy

data.name: About_Privacy_Lead
data.value: We process as little personal data as possible, in line with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP).

data.name: About_Privacy_Visit_Title
data.value: Visiting the website

data.name: About_Privacy_Visit_Text
data.value: You do not need an account to visit. We set no tracking or advertising cookies. For troubleshooting, the app writes operational data (requested address, time, errors) to a log, without IP address. We keep it for at most 30 days.

data.name: About_Privacy_Hosting_Title
data.value: Hosting

data.name: About_Privacy_Hosting_Text
data.value: Website, database and photos are hosted by Microsoft Azure in the Switzerland North region. Cloudflare delivers pages and images and protects against attacks. In doing so, Cloudflare processes your IP address. Cloudflare is a company based in the USA; the data may therefore also be processed outside Switzerland.

data.name: About_Privacy_Account_Title
data.value: Account

data.name: About_Privacy_Account_Text
data.value: Only contributors need an account: e-mail address, display name and the password as a hash. Signing in uses a technically necessary cookie, forms use a cookie that protects against misuse. Confirmation and password reset mails go only to you.

data.name: About_Privacy_Contributions_Title
data.value: Contributions and photos

data.name: About_Privacy_Contributions_Text
data.value: Changes appear in the versions of a site, with your name only if you agree. We show photos with the photographer’s name. The public image sizes contain no GPS or camera data; the original stays private.

data.name: About_Privacy_Location_Title
data.value: Location and maps

data.name: About_Privacy_Location_Text
data.value: «Near me» asks your browser for your location. The coordinate is only part of the search address and may therefore appear in the app’s log. We do not analyse it and do not store it in an account. Your browser loads map tiles directly from swisstopo (geo.admin.ch); swisstopo sees your IP address. Your browser remembers the choice of map or aerial image.

data.name: About_Privacy_Routes_Title
data.value: Routes

data.name: About_Privacy_Routes_Text
data.value: The links to Google Maps and Apple Maps only transmit the site’s coordinate when you click them.

data.name: About_Privacy_Rights_Title
data.value: Your rights

data.name: About_Privacy_Rights_Text
data.value: Under «My data» you see all data about your account and can download it. Under «Delete account» you delete your account: private photos and all originals are deleted, versions remain without a name. Questions and requests without an account via the
